verdict.rationale: Temporal documents a single command, `temporal server start-dev`, that starts a complete local Temporal Service with Web UI via the CLI's development server. Its TypeScript testing suite provides a test server that supports time skipping. Mocking Activities (steps) in unit tests is not documented anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: documented Activity mocking utilities, testing-suite coverage beyond the TypeScript SDK, independent hands-on corroboration of the local dev and testing experience.

support.subject: As a backend developer, one command runs the whole engine locally, and testing utilities let me unit-test workflows with time skipping and mocked steps

citations.quote: This starts a complete Temporal Service with Web UI on your local machine.
The CLI includes a local Temporal development service for fast feedback while building or testing your application.
Because the test server supports skipping time, use the test server for both end-to-end and integration tests with Workers.
